item.title: 【Music Videos】BEATPELLA HOUSE - Freaky Monday [E] [2160p | HEVC 10-bit | PCM]
item.description:
Genre: Hip Hop
Style: Beatbox
Year: 2025
Video Source: YouTube, 2160p
Audio Source: Qobuz

"Freaky Monday" is a song by South Korean beatbox-acapella group Beatpella House, released on June 30, 2025. The song was written by Wing (lyrics), and composed by Sinzo, Yella.E, Wing, Hellcat, Huckle, and Hiss. The track features a high-energy beatbox arrangement and lyrics that humorously express the frustration of a long, seemingly endless Monday, with the chorus emphasizing the feeling of being stuck in a "freaky Monday" despite it feeling like Thursday.

Beatpella House formed in October 2022 through the collaboration of the duo Beatpella (Yella.E and Hiss), the duo Jackpot (Wing and Hellcat), and beatboxer Huckle. The group consists of five members: Yella.E (lead vocalist and rapper), Hiss (harmonies and melodies), Wing (rhythm and groove), Hellcat (aggressive drumlines and ad-libs), and Huckle (deep bass and low frequencies). Their first track as Beatpella House, a cover of BLACKPINK's "Pink Venom," was released in March 2023.

The group has received recognition for their work, including a 2025 Korea Creative Content Agency Award at the K-EXPO. They also performed a collaboration with the K-pop group LE SSERAFIM in April 2025, covering their songs "Easy," "Hot," and "Crazy". Additionally, Beatpella House participated in a Samsung advertisement in August 2025 featuring their song "Eternal Ember" from their first EP, "What’s in My Room?".

The song's official video, directed by SINZO, was released on YouTube on June 30, 2025. Three months later it has gathered more than 4.5 million views.
